title: io.stintflow.examples.meeting-recorded.v1 — data (SDD 3a.6, 4.6)
description: A meeting was recorded. The CloudEvent's type is io.stintflow.examples.meeting-recorded.v1 and its subject is the meetingId. Ids, a pointer and a label only: never a title, a description or any content of the meeting. Changes are additive only.

meetingId.description: The meeting's id; also the idempotency key of its publication

audioRef.description: Pointer to the raw audio, in a blob of a restricted retention class (e.g. s3://bucket/retention/raw-audio/m-001.wav)

label.description: The recording's sensitivity (SDD 3a.5): a raw recording is restricted; absent or unknown reads as restricted
